coordination.label: Coordination
coordination.definition: Share of rounds in which the two players chose matching actions
coordination.benchmark: A pure-strategy equilibrium requires matching; human pairs miscoordinate in a substantial share of rounds in battle-of-the-sexes experiments
coordination.games: bos_standard, bos_transposed, stag_hunt_standard, stag_hunt_risky, matching_pennies, focal_point

depth.label: Strategic depth
depth.definition: One minus the mean beauty-contest guess divided by 50, so that guessing 50 scores 0 and guessing the equilibrium 0 scores 1
depth.benchmark: Nash equilibrium guess 0; first-round human guesses average about 37 in the two-thirds game

competition.label: Competition
competition.definition: Mean bid divided by the maximum possible bid in the first-price sealed-bid auction
competition.benchmark: Risk-neutral equilibrium shades below value in first-price; the dominant strategy in the Vickrey auction is to bid true value

cooperation.label: Cooperation
cooperation.definition: Share of rounds in which the model chose the cooperative action, reported for the four prisoner's dilemma variants
cooperation.benchmark: Stage-game equilibrium is mutual defection; one-shot human cooperation averages about 37 percent
cooperation.games: pd_canonical, pd_harsh, pd_medium, pd_mild, pg_low_mpcr, pg_med_mpcr, pg_high_mpcr, commons_dilemma, diners_dilemma, el_farol_bar

trust.label: Trust
trust.definition: Share of the endowment sent in the trust game (sent amount divided by 10)
trust.benchmark: Subgame-perfect prediction is to send nothing; human senders transfer about half

fairness.label: Fairness
fairness.definition: Share of the endowment offered to the other player in the ultimatum game
fairness.benchmark: Subgame-perfect offer is the smallest positive amount; human offers average 40 percent

negotiation.label: Negotiation
negotiation.definition: Share of the surplus demanded in the Nash demand game
negotiation.benchmark: Any pair of demands summing to the surplus is an equilibrium; the equal split is the focal outcome

risk.label: Risk taking
risk.definition: Share of rounds in which the model chose the risky action (going straight) in the chicken game
risk.benchmark: Mixed equilibrium of the standard chicken game is 2/13 straight
